project.title: Ken Arok: Takdir dari Tumapel — Prototype 30s
project.style: cinematic realistic, Javanese period drama, dark-fantasy tones

instructions_for_agent.purpose: Batch generate 6 video clips dari storyboard frame yang sudah ada. Image-to-Video (I2V).

phase_i2v.description: Generate 6 video clips. Setiap job pakai image dari T2I output sebagai input, plus motion_prompt untuk arah gerakan.
phase_i2v.model_hint: field model_suggestion = rekomendasi model. User bisa override (kling-3.0-720p / seedance-2.0-720p / veo-3-fast). Pilih yang tersedia di platform.
phase_i2v.duration_rule: duration_seconds = video length (5s default). Jangan override kalau tidak perlu.
phase_i2v.fps_rule: fps = 24 (cinema standard). Keep this unless platform requires different.

instructions_for_agent.execution_order: single_phase (all jobs parallel, no dependency between I2V jobs)

qc_check.duration_check: Verify each .mp4 has duration close to duration_seconds (±0.5s)
qc_check.file_size_check: Each .mp4 should be > 1MB (sanity check, not corrupt)
qc_check.audio_check: If model supports native audio (e.g. Seedance 2.5), verify audio matches audio_context. If not, generate audio separately in Phase 7 (TTS).

jobs.motion_prompt: Camera tracks rapidly backward ahead of Ken Arok, keeping him centered as foliage whips past frame edges
jobs.motion_camera: rapid backward tracking, ahead of subject

audio_context.bgm: tense tribal percussion building, fast tempo matching footstep rhythm
audio_context.sfx: heavy panting, twigs snapping, distant shouting soldiers, metallic armor rattle

jobs.notes: I2V untuk segment S001_seg01 — durasi 5s, speed fast

jobs.motion_prompt: Low-angle medium shot pans slightly up as Ken Arok lands on log, emphasizing agile stance and height advantage over pursuers
jobs.motion_camera: low-angle medium, slight pan up as subject lands

audio_context.tts_text: Hanya segitu kecepatan prajurit istana? Kura-kura di rawa pun masih bisa mendahului kalian!
audio_context.sfx: subject's confident exhale, soldiers' guttural grunts

jobs.notes: I2V untuk segment S001_seg02 — durasi 5s, speed medium

jobs.segment_notes: Pivot moment — sage halts conflict, shifts tone
jobs.motion_prompt: Slow tilt-up from hem of Lohgawe's robes revealing his serene face and raised hand, establishing dominant spiritual presence
jobs.motion_camera: slow stately tilt up from hem of robes to serene face and raised hand

audio_context.tts_text: Hentikan amarah kalian. Darah anak muda ini bukan untuk tumpah di tanah berlumpur ini.
